title: While a heard erase's reads keep failing (L1), a second refused save under the same erase loses its typed value with no words
evidence: Partial 2026-11-14 (PR 1731): the machine tracks the latest read of a heard erase by id and holds unreachable; the visible line and its words wait for Brad (PR 2). Known, invisible (PR 1731 review): outside settled, a new identity's arrival inherits the current `reads` id (erase-machine.ts ~:284), so an older read's failure can mark that new erase failed while erasing or loading; never visible, since `unreachable` needs settled and every exit mints a new id or drops heard. Was: widget-src/src/lib/erase-machine.ts header, L1 residual: the first refusal under an erase says WRITE_REFUSED and every refused save while the erase is heard re-reads (Q3), but Q4 keys the alert on the erase asked under, so a repeat refusal is silent and its typed value goes. Pinned by widget-src/src/hooks/useRecordApply.erase.test.tsx "two remote erases whose reads fail, then a refused save under the old erase: it re-reads". Fix (Fable): a visible "cannot reach your record" state while a heard erase is unread; a separate design after fix 4
